name: godot-stagehand-claude-mod-toolchain
description: Dev-only toolchain for the Claude Code plugin mod in integrations/claude-code. Never ships.

scripts.lint: cd ../.. && eslint -c tools/claude-mod/eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings=0 integrations/claude-code/hooks tools/claude-mod/check-calls.mjs tools/claude-mod/eslint.config.mjs
scripts.validate: claude plugin validate --strict ../../integrations/claude-code && claude plugin validate --strict ../..
scripts.check: npm run types && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run validate && npm run calls && npm run test
